name: kmp-reflect-npm-workspace
description: npm workspace anchor for the Kotlin/JS build. The browserslist entry is found by walking up from the generated site directory: without it Babel has no targets and downlevels async/await to a regenerator state machine, which turns the Docusaurus build into an ES5 bundle. There are no runtime npm dependencies here — the docs site's @docusaurus/* packages come with the ktjs-docusaurus klib.
